About Me

Building AI that's
powerful & explainable

I'm a Data Scientist and AI/ML Engineer passionate about building systems that don't just perform well — they explain why. From ensemble models with SHAP/LIME explainability to autonomous LangGraph agents, I work across the full ML lifecycle.

My work spans credit risk, healthcare diagnostics, evolutionary optimization, and autonomous AI agents. I care deeply about both model performance and model transparency — especially in high-stakes domains where decisions need to be understood and trusted.

I'm actively looking for roles where I can push the frontier of applied ML, MLOps, and AI agent systems.

Genetic Algorithm Optimizer
Evolutionary solver — 60× faster than brute-force

An evolutionary optimizer for the 0/1 Knapsack problem using DEAP — achieving near-optimal solutions across 1,000+ combinations in 50 generations, with 60× speed gain over exhaustive search.

Highlights

  • Full GA pipeline: population init, fitness eval, tournament selection, crossover, bit-flip mutation
  • 97% optimal solution rate across 1,000+ test combinations within 50 generations
  • 45% faster convergence vs standard GA via adaptive parameter tuning
  • 60× faster than brute-force through evolutionary pruning of the search space

LangGraph AI Agent
Stateful multi-step autonomous task executor

A stateful autonomous agent built with LangGraph — capable of decomposing high-level goals into sub-tasks, calling external tools, and dynamically re-planning based on intermediate outcomes.

Highlights

  • Conditional edge routing enables dynamic re-planning mid-execution
  • Autonomously decomposes goals into sequential sub-tasks with tool invocations
  • Human-in-the-loop checkpoints for approval on high-stakes decisions
